title: Häubchen
nothing: Not following any window. Pick one with /pip
no-player: Player '{player}' is not installed. Set the player command in Häubchen's settings

empty.title: No windows to follow
empty.subtitle: Try /pip twitch <channel>, /pip yt <id> or a URL

reset.title: Reset size and position
reset.subtitle: Back to the corner and size from the settings

auto_follow.label: Auto-follow streams
auto_follow.description: Follow a window by itself when its title shows Twitch, YouTube or Kick, or when it is the player Häubchen opened. Lets go when the tab moves off the stream, and never grabs a window you stopped following

size.label: Size
size.description: Width of the corner player as a share of the monitor width; height follows at 16:9

margin.label: Margin
margin.description: Gap to the screen edge and the bar, in logical pixels

player_command.label: Player command
player_command.description: Run for /pip twitch, yt, kick and URLs. {url} is replaced by the stream as one argument. mpv needs yt-dlp for Twitch and YouTube

player_class.label: Player window class
player_class.description: The class the player's window opens with, so Häubchen can follow it. Must match the command's app id

unsupported.title: Compositor not supported
unsupported.subtitle: Häubchen works on Hyprland, sway and niri
